svg.text: LLM QUANTIZATION SELECTION: BF16 VS. BLOCK-WISE FP8 (1X128/128X128) VS. W4A16 MARLIN VS. NVFP4
Fine-Grained Block FP8 (1x128 Act × 128x128 Weight) Retains 99.8% Accuracy at 2.18x Goodput
H200/B200 Evaluation: Tier 1 BF16 ($0.92/1M) vs. Tier 2 Per-Tensor FP8 (94.2% Acc) vs. Tier 3 W4A16 Marlin vs. Tier 4 ($0.36/1M)
⛔ Tier 2 Traps: Per-Tensor Outlier Clipping & SKU Mismatch
1. Why Static Per-Tensor FP8 Degrades MoE & Reasoning (-5.8% Acc):
• SwiGLU & MoE layers produce extreme activation outlier channels;
a single global FP8 scale clips normal channels to zero!
2. Running `FP8` on `A100` (No Native FP8 TensorCore Trap):
• A100 (Ampere SM80) lacks FP8 TensorCores; running FP8 weights on
A100 forces software dequantization without 2x FLOPs speedup!
3. `W4A16 AWQ/Marlin` Compute Bottleneck at High Batch (`B >= 32`):
• W4A16 dequantizes INT4 weights to FP16 before GEMM (`1x` FLOPs)
Tier 1 BF16 vs. Tier 2 Naive Per-Tensor FP8 Impact:
• Tier 1 BF16: 100% Accuracy, but only 980 Goodput tok/s ($0.92/1M)
• Tier 2 Naive FP8: Accuracy drops to 94.2% on Math/Coding!
• Uncalibrated INT4KV4: Destroys long-context needle retrieval
🏆 Tier 4: Fine-Grained Block FP8 & Blackwell NVFP4
1. DeepSeek-Style Block-Wise `FP8 E4M3` (`1x128` × `128x128`):
• Quantizes activations per `1x128` token tile and weights per
`128x128` block—isolating outliers & keeping `99.8%` accuracy!
2. Hardware-Matched Quantization Selection Rule:
• `A100`: Choose `W4A16 AWQ Marlin` | `H100/H200/L40S`: Choose
`Block FP8 W8A8KV8` | `B200/GB200`: Choose `NVFP4` (16-elem scale)
3. Batch-Size Crossover (`B <= 16` W4A16 vs. `B >= 24` W8A8 FP8):
• W8A8 FP8 unlocks `2x` TensorCore TFLOPS (`1,979 TFLOPS` on H200)
Tier 4 Verified Production Benchmarks:
• Relative Accuracy Retention: 99.8% (Statistically indistinguishable)
• Goodput: 2,140 tok/s/GPU (2.18x vs. BF16) | P99 TPOT: 12.9ms
• Cost per 1M Tokens: $0.36 / 1M (-60.9% savings vs. BF16)
